basic_details.job_title: KRCL Dy Chief Electrical Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: Candidates must be Below 50 years as on the date of Notification.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | dy. chief electrical engineer: IRSEE officer should have completed minimum 5 years of Railway service and above & should be presently working in JAG/SS. The officer having service experience in design, planning, construction, execution of Railway Electrification projects (RE)/ Operation & Maintenance of the power supply installations, OHE and RC equipment / maintenance & operation of electric locomotives and electric multiple unit (EMU) stocks outside the electric loco shed and/or Train operation, Crew management / Maintenance and operation of the Electric Locos based in the shed/ Electrical General Services in Indian Railway/PSUs/Metro. Candidate should have knowledge of the relevant specification i.e. Railway Board & RDSO and other relevant codes & specifications.

salary_details.pay_scale: JAG/SS (As per 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-12 or Level-11)
salary_details.dy. chief electrical engineer: JAG/SS as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-12. Or as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-11.
salary_details.details: The officer will draw pay and allowances as per DOPT instructions, which would have been admissible to him/her from time to time on the Railways plus deputation (duty) allowance.

how_to_apply: Download the official notification and prescribed proforma (Annexure 'A') from the official website www.konkanrailway.com.
Fill in the prescribed application format completely with all required personal and professional details.

Forward your application through your proper channel with the approval of the Competent Authority well in advance, i.e., at least 07 days prior to the last date of vacancy notice, as required by Railway Board letter no. 2018/E(O)II/41/1 dated 08/02/2023.
Forward an advance copy of the application along with enclosures at the email address: [email protected].
Send the complete filled-in application by post to The Chief Personnel Officer, KRCL, C.B.D Belapur, Navi Mumbai, PIN 400614.
important_instructions: Applications of officers working in Zonal Railways/PUS for deputation to Railway PSUs/Autonomous Bodies and all other Organizations will be forwarded with the approval of the Competent Authority in Ministry. KRCL will consider applications of only those officers whose applications are forwarded by Railway Board. Eligible suitable applicants will be short-listed on the basis of eligibility and experience, if required, as per Vacancy Notice. Selection criteria will be as mentioned in Ministry of Railway, Railway Board's letter No.2017/E(O)II/41/5 dated 25.05.2017 and no.2018/E(O)II/41/1 dated 07.03.2018. Retention of Railway accommodation is permissible as per Board's guidelines issued from time to time during deputation tenure in KRCL. KRCL has been permitted exemption from the rule of immediate absorption up to 31/12/2026. The term of deputation is 3 years, normal term of deputation, extendable up to five (05) years.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: This is a recruitment notification issued by Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) for filling up 3 posts of Dy. Chief Electrical Engineer on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 03 vacancies available for the post of Dy. Chief Electrical Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 06/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The candidate must be an IRSEE officer who has completed a minimum of 5 years of Railway service and above, and should be presently working in JAG/SS with relevant field experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 50 years of age as on the date of notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible officers must apply in the prescribed proforma (Annexure 'A'), route it through proper channel to Railway Board, forward an advance copy via email to [email protected], and send the completed application by post to The Chief Personnel Officer, KRCL, C.B.D Belapur, Navi Mumbai, PIN 400614.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for KRCL Dy. Chief Electrical Engineer?
faq.answer: Selected officers will draw pay in JAG/SS as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-12 or Level-11, along with deputation duty allowance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Belapur, Navi Mumbai.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of deputation?
faq.answer: The normal term of deputation is 3 years, which is extendable up to five (05) years.
